storyline:
Here is the OCR transcription for the text in your uploaded image (brave_0w4FCxZ9q8.jpg):

"There's nobody left on Earth anymore."

A kindred world that has reached its goal.
In the city of the future without mortality or strife, an unavoidable doom will be defined.

As they multiply out of control, Moon Cancers compete in a grand election for the world's highest honor. Expose the cancer festering in the heart of the many schemes on the moon.

"Bellum Novae Humanitatis, Archetype Inception"

The true enemy threatens the moon.
Its name is...
summary: The third out of 4 Ordeal Call chapters, focusing on the Mooncancer class.
